note: Reference lens set. Adapt, rename or replace lenses for your codebase; keep 25 distinct agents if you claim a 25-agent panel.

perspectives.name: Core logic correctness
perspectives.focus: Trace main code paths against stated behavior; off-by-one, wrong denominators, unhandled branches.

perspectives.name: Edge-case inputs
perspectives.focus: Empty, huge, malformed, non-ASCII, deeply nested and boundary inputs; exit codes.

perspectives.name: API and network clients
perspectives.focus: Timeouts, retries, redirects, TLS, key handling, error propagation.

perspectives.name: Storage and state
perspectives.focus: Atomic writes, schema drift, concurrency, partial failure, cleanup.

perspectives.name: Protocol and interface contracts
perspectives.focus: CLI, JSON-RPC/MCP and schema validation versus documented contracts.

perspectives.name: First-run flow
perspectives.focus: Follow the quickstart cold, copy-paste every command, note each friction or failure.

perspectives.name: CLI and output UX
perspectives.focus: Messages, exit codes, readability, console encodings, actionable errors.

perspectives.name: Host and IDE integration
perspectives.focus: Config files per host, paths, working directory assumptions, scoped compatibility claims.

perspectives.name: Visual and rendering
perspectives.focus: Any UI, rendered docs, tables, screenshots; contrast, layout, overflow. Mark N/A if none.

perspectives.name: Accessibility and i18n
perspectives.focus: Unicode, locale, screen-reader-friendly output, language assumptions.

perspectives.name: Secrets and privacy
perspectives.focus: Keys, tokens, emails, personal data in files, logs and git history.

perspectives.name: Injection and trust boundaries
perspectives.focus: Untrusted input into prompts, shells, paths, deserialization.

perspectives.name: Dependencies and supply chain
perspectives.focus: Pins, licenses, vendored code provenance, optional installs.

perspectives.name: Failure modes
perspectives.focus: Crash, kill, disk full, network down; fail-closed versus silent corruption.

perspectives.name: Abuse and resource limits
perspectives.focus: Cost runaway, unbounded loops, rate limits, size limits.

perspectives.name: Documentation accuracy
perspectives.focus: Every documented command, path and number versus the code and tree.

perspectives.name: Claims versus evidence
perspectives.focus: Each quality, benchmark or compatibility claim has evidence or an untested label.

perspectives.name: Onboarding and examples
perspectives.focus: Examples run, fixtures present in a cold clone, prerequisites stated.

perspectives.name: Changelog and versioning
perspectives.focus: Changelog matches the diff; version identifiers consistent.

perspectives.name: License and attribution
perspectives.focus: Licenses, third-party notices, copied content provenance.

perspectives.name: Test coverage
perspectives.focus: Untested branches, tests that cannot fail, missing regressions for fixed bugs.

perspectives.name: Test reliability
perspectives.focus: Flakiness, order dependence, network or time dependence, platform assumptions.

perspectives.name: Reproducibility
perspectives.focus: Fresh clone at the frozen SHA builds and passes; no hidden local state.

perspectives.name: Maintainability
perspectives.focus: Dead code, duplication, naming, module boundaries, hard-coded values.

perspectives.name: Adversarial skeptic
perspectives.focus: Try to break the other lenses' assumptions; hunt what no other lens covers.
